verdict.rationale: A community comment in what appears to be a launch thread says "martin desktop is finally here" and describes using it alongside VS Code, so an official desktop app likely exists. No evidence shows OS-level global shortcuts or screen access. The documented "custom shortcuts" are multi-step action macros, not OS keyboard shortcuts, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: first-party docs for the desktop app, OS-level/global hotkeys, screen-content access or awareness.
